From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: laura.bennett@redwood.ai, ben.carter@redwood.ai, marcus.lin@redwood.ai, rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai, Sanjay Patel <sanjay@acme.com>; Hannah Yeo <hannah.yeo@acme.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Sep 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: QBR ledger rollup + account annotations (forecast reconciliation)

Team / Acme —

As part of next week's QBR I put together a ledger-style rollup for Acme accounts to reconcile the forecast figures we've been carrying vs. what field owners have confirmed. Attached: QBR_Account_Ledger_v1.xlsx (brand-new tab per account + variance comments).

Ask (short):
- Internal owners (Laura, Ben, Marcus, Rishi): please add a 1-2 line annotation per account by EOD Friday (9/24). Focus on: primary risk, expected close cadence, and any gating items.
- Acme: Sanjay / Hannah — can you confirm the commercial cadence and call out any procurement timing you expect to impact the Q4 delivery window?

I've highlighted three accounts with >20% variance vs. our previous forecast; those are on tab 'High Variance'. Notable callouts: billing timing shift for Acme-Platform renewal and a scope contraction for Acme-Integrations.

Attachments: QBR_Account_Ledger_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet)

Thanks — Marissa

--
Marissa Cole
Sr. Sales Strategy Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0148
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: QBR ledger rollup + account annotations (forecast reconciliation)

Marissa —

Got it and thanks for pulling the ledger together. Quick notes from my first pass on 'High Variance' tab:
- Acme-Platform: change tied to their internal legal review; procurement expected mid-Oct (falls into Q4 but may slip). I'm marking "probable" at 70%.
- Acme-Integrations: technical POC pushed to Oct; field needs a case study before they sign.

I'll add short annotations for the 5 accounts I own by EOD Thursday. For clarity, do you want us to include a suggested ask (discount/credit) per account in the annotations or leave commercial levers to leadership?

Laura

Marissa / Laura —

Thanks for the ledger. A couple of quick clarifications from our side:
- Acme-Platform renewal: finance has a standing review window in week of Oct 10. We expect to sign off then but legal requires updated DPA language; timeline could slip up to 2 weeks if legal requests changes.
- Acme-Integrations: we delayed the POC because of resource constraints on our side; if Redwood can provide a 1-week proof-of-implementation in our sandbox (no cost), we can accelerate to early Oct.

I'll mark internal owners and confirm procurement milestones by Friday.

Best,
Sanjay

Looping in my notes for the accounts I own. See quick inline annotations in the ledger (tab 'Ben-notes') and short summary below:
- Acme-Analytics: pacing slower; estimated close mid-Oct, moving to 60% probability. Gating = data ingestion test.
- Acme-Edge: VP sponsor confirmed; procurement is green but they want a 30-day review post-PO. Keep as 80%.

If anyone wants me to surface a suggested commercial concession on Acme-Analytics to move deal earlier, say so and I'll draft two options (one simple credit, one pilot discount).

Ben

Folks —

Thanks for the fast turn. I've merged everyone's annotations into the ledger and created a 'ConsolidatedForQBR' tab. Key actions I added:
- Rishi: please confirm legal/KMS closure timing for Acme-Platform (Sanity check with Security) — due Mon 9/27.
- Marcus: coordinate a 1-week sandbox POC for Acme-Integrations if we greenlight the no-cost proof (Sanjay asked). Note owner and resourcing in the ledger.
- Laura: please flag if you want leadership to surface a commercial concession; indicate suggested amount in the 'CommercialLevers' column.

I'm prepping the QBR slide packet this afternoon. Attaching the consolidated ledger + the mutual action plan draft we'll share with Acme before the meeting.

Attachments: QBR_Account_Ledger_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet), ACME_Mutual_Action_Plan.pdf (pdf)

Thanks — Marissa

- Acme-Platform: legal has the DPA change request and security is validating encryption/TLS posture. I expect closure by Tue 9/28 if legal's comments are limited to standard DPA addendum. Marking as 75% until I have final text.

Rishi
